originalAlarm.description: Memory dynamically allocated by `malloc` on line 26 is not freed after the last access at line 26, column 3.

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE (NEW, CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED): When CONFIG_FEATURE_CLEAN_UP=false, buf is malloc'd at line 26 but the #ifdef CLEAN_UP block (lines 29-33) is not compiled, so free(buf) is never called. The malloc'd buffer leaks at function return. This is a genuine memory leak. NEW BUG: The known vbdb bug for eef2317b9f5.c is UninitializedVariable when CLEAN_UP=true — if cmd==8, goto all_done skips the malloc at line 26, leaving buf uninitialized; the CLEAN_UP block then calls 'if (buf)' on uninitialized data and potentially free(garbage). The MemoryLeak when CLEAN_UP=false is a separate, real issue. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: When CLEAN_UP=true, free(buf) is called (when buf is valid), so no leak. The presence condition CLEAN_UP=false correctly identifies the only configuration where the leak occurs.
